source: proposed by claude-haiku-5-5 (group-v1) from run dev500

access.description: Users cannot log in or are shown errors when attempting to sign in, including password and phone number rejections.
access.name: Login failure

access.description: Users are logged out of the account without action and then cannot sign back in.
access.name: Unexpected logout

access.description: The app reports no internet connection during login even though other apps and the device are online.
access.name: False no-internet error

access.description: Users lose access to their account or saved playlists after a suspected hack or account compromise.
access.name: Account access loss from security issues

billing.description: Basic features such as skipping, choosing songs, replaying, and viewing lyrics now require a premium subscription.
billing.name: Features moved behind premium

billing.description: Free users are limited to a small number of skips per hour or day.
billing.name: Skip limit

billing.description: Users are repeatedly shown prompts to try or buy premium, interrupting use.
billing.name: Frequent premium upsell prompts

billing.description: Users cannot complete a premium subscription purchase and see a blank page or get stuck after subscribing.
billing.name: Subscription purchase failure

catalog.description: Users cannot find certain songs or artists, or the catalog feels limited or empty.
catalog.name: Missing songs

catalog.description: Users dislike the irrelevant or unwanted song recommendations, which persist even when turned off.
catalog.name: Recommendation quality

catalog.description: Users find that full songs are replaced by 30-second clips or that podcasts are hard to access.
catalog.name: Podcast and preview limitations

catalog.description: The search function within playlists was removed, making it hard to find songs.
catalog.name: Playlist search removed

downloads.description: Previously downloaded songs are gone when users go offline or after storage changes.
downloads.name: Downloaded content disappears

downloads.description: Offline mode does not work, or downloaded content cannot be accessed without a connection.
downloads.name: Offline mode failure

downloads.description: Song downloads get stuck in the background and only resume when the app is opened.
downloads.name: Background downloads stall

other.description: Users express broad disappointment with the latest update without citing a specific issue.
other.name: Dissatisfaction with recent update

other.description: Users object to specific content, artists, or platform stances and say they will stop using the app.
other.name: Content and political concerns

other.description: Users post profanity, insults, or very short negative remarks without describing a specific problem.
other.name: Abusive or non-specific feedback

playback.description: The app crashes on launch, gets stuck on the loading screen, or stops playback mid-song, especially after updates.
playback.name: App crashes and freezes

playback.description: Music stops or fails to play because the app wrongly reports no connection, including offline mode and Wi-Fi issues.
playback.name: Playback connectivity errors

playback.description: Casting to other devices, Google Assistant, and alarm integrations fail to start or control playback.
playback.name: Device casting and assistant integration

playback.description: Users report poor sound quality compared to other apps or lagging podcast playback.
playback.name: Audio quality and lag

support.description: Users report that problems persist after reporting them or after reinstalling, with no visible fix.
support.name: No response to reported issues

usability.description: Users complain about too many ads, ads played back-to-back, and long unskippable ad breaks.
usability.name: Excessive or unskippable ads

usability.description: The app plays different songs than selected, forces shuffle, or inserts recommended tracks into playlists and liked songs.
usability.name: Unwanted autoplay and shuffle behavior

usability.description: Users find the redesigned home screen, menus, and icons harder to use and navigate.
usability.name: Layout and navigation changes

usability.description: Users dislike the lyrics font or find that lyrics are not shown or fail to load.
usability.name: Lyrics display and font
